title: Witzig
description: A mod without direction... but it can show you the direction.
body:
Have you ever wanted to point others in a direction, but lacked quite the obvious "in-your-face" direction indicator? Have you ever wanted a remote control for note blocks? And most important: how fast can boats _really_ go?

**Witzig** (German for _"funny"_) is an open-source mod in **<font color=red>early development</font>** adding various versatile utilities that would be too small for mods of their own, but together equal quite the funny combination (hence the name).

The mod is built **for the Fabric loader** and **requires [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api/)**!

## Documentation
Check out **[the full documentation](https://infi.github.io/witzig/)** for instructions, recipes and a list of additions!

## Gallery
See **[Gallery](https://modrinth.com/mod/witzig/gallery)** for images of the mod in action.
